# Facts

`cinnabar:extension/facts@0.1.0`

Native item and effect facts from the pinned tables and the installation's food definitions.
Requires player-state authority. A callback may make `MAX_FACT_READS` reads, counted apart
from player-state reads; one more traps it.

**Grants:** `player_state`.

## Types

<a id="type-food"></a>

### `food`

Food attributes from an installed item definition; saturation is a modifier, not current saturation.

```wit
record food {
    nutrition: u32,
    saturation-modifier: f32,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `nutrition` | `u32` |  |
| `saturation-modifier` | `f32` |  |

<a id="type-potion-effect"></a>

### `potion-effect`

Amplifier is zero-based; duration none is instant.

```wit
record potion-effect {
    effect-id: s32,
    amplifier: s32,
    duration-ticks: option<u64>,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `effect-id` | `s32` |  |
| `amplifier` | `s32` |  |
| `duration-ticks` | `option<u64>` |  |

<a id="type-item-facts"></a>

### `item-facts`

Known item properties; absent properties must not be treated as zero.

```wit
record item-facts {
    max-durability: option<u32>,
    food: option<food>,
    potion-effects: list<potion-effect>,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `max-durability` | `option<u32>` | The pinned maximum; none for items that take no damage or whose maximum is unknown. |
| `food` | `option<food>` | The installation's food definition for the identifier or its pinned legacy name.<br>Server item components are not consulted; `vitals.held-food` reports those. |
| `potion-effects` | `list<potion-effect>` | The effects of the potion that potions, splash and lingering potions carry by<br>metadata, and tipped arrows by metadata minus one. Durations are the potion's own, a<br>quarter of them for lingering potions; tipped arrows report the carried potion's. |

Types: [`food`](facts.md#type-food), [`potion-effect`](facts.md#type-potion-effect).

<a id="type-food-item"></a>

### `food-item`

One installed food definition; metadata none applies to every variant of the item.

```wit
record food-item {
    identifier: string,
    metadata: option<u32>,
    food: food,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `identifier` | `string` |  |
| `metadata` | `option<u32>` |  |
| `food` | `food` |  |

Types: [`food`](facts.md#type-food).

<a id="type-effect-facts"></a>

### `effect-facts`

A status effect's localization key and HUD icon texture as JSON-UI names it, without an
extension; the texture is empty for effects without a HUD icon.

```wit
record effect-facts {
    name-key: string,
    texture: string,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name-key` | `string` |  |
| `texture` | `string` |  |

## Functions

<a id="read-item"></a>

### `read-item`

```wit
read-item: func(identifier: string, metadata: u32) -> result<option<item-facts>, string>;
```

None when neither the pinned item facts nor the installed food know the identifier.

Types: [`item-facts`](facts.md#type-item-facts).

<a id="read-foods"></a>

### `read-foods`

```wit
read-foods: func() -> result<list<food-item>, string>;
```

Every item the installation's food table defines, by the identifiers `read-item`
resolves: a pinned legacy name is listed as the items that alias it. The table defines
food per identifier, so metadata is none. Sorted by identifier, at most
`facts::MAX_FOOD_ITEMS`, keeping the first; identifiers over `MAX_ITEM_IDENTIFIER_BYTES`
are left out. Empty while no food table is installed. One read.

Types: [`food-item`](facts.md#type-food-item).

<a id="read-effect"></a>

### `read-effect`

```wit
read-effect: func(effect-id: s32) -> result<option<effect-facts>, string>;
```

None for an unknown effect id.

Types: [`effect-facts`](facts.md#type-effect-facts).
